name: Being Gay
overview: The Scriptures clearly teach that homosexual acts are considered an abomination, as stated in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13, where such behavior is strictly prohibited and carries severe consequences. Deuteronomy 23:1 further indicates that those who are physically altered, which some interpret in relation to sexual identity, are excluded from the assembly of the LORD. Isaiah 56:3 offers compassion to eunuchs who remain faithful to God, affirming their place within His people despite physical differences. Additionally, Ezekiel 16:49 highlights that the sin of Sodom was not homosexuality itself but pride, excess, and neglect of the needy, emphasizing the broader context of biblical morality.
